where.if: AND (c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id, article_id, parent_id, root_id, content, blogger, parent_nickname, nickname, email, avatar, website, handle, notice, send, visible, browser, system_info, ip, province, city, district, create_time FROM blog_comment WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND visible = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.blogger, c.parent_nickname, c.nickname, c.email, c.avatar, c.website, c.handle, c.notice, c.send, c.visible, c.browser, c.system_info, c.ip, c.province, c.city, c.district, c.create_time, a.title AS article_title FROM blog_comment c LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON a.id = c.article_id
ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_comment (id, article_id, parent_id, root_id, content, blogger, parent_nickname, nickname, email, avatar, website, handle, notice, send, visible, browser, system_info, ip, province, city, district) VALUES (#{id}, #{articleId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{content}, #{blogger}, #{parentNickname}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{website}, #{handle}, #{notice}, #{send}, #{visible}, #{browser}, #{systemInfo}, #{ip}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_comment SET handle = #{handle} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_comment SET visible = #{visible} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.content, c.nickname, c.create_time, a.title AS article_title FROM blog_comment c LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON a.id = c.article_id ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_comment WHERE ip = #{ip} AND IFNULL(blogger, 0) = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_comment WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND IFNULL(blogger, 0) = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
